facts.fact: Le Soleil reports the BCEAO's PI-SPI instant interoperable payment platform, launched 30 September 2025, carries bank-wallet transfers in Senegal and is mandatory from 2 November 2026.
Le Soleil reports PI-SPI, the BCEAO's platform, is the mandatory route for interoperable e-money transactions across the eight UEMOA states including Senegal.
